evals.name: feature-with-noise
evals.prompt: I just wrapped up a change to our order service and need to open a PR. The full diff of my branch is in feature-with-noise.diff — it's the retry stuff plus whatever npm dragged in. Can you write the PR description? Save it as pr-description.md.
evals.expected_output: A short reviewer-focused description leading with the retry/backoff behavior added to the API client. Lockfile churn and formatting-only changes ignored or reduced to a single aggregate mention. No file-by-file inventory.
assertions: Title and opening sentences lead with the retry/backoff behavior added to the API client
Lockfile/dependency churn gets at most one aggregate mention — no itemized package-lock.json or integrity-hash details
The formatting-only rewrite of src/utils/format.js is not presented as a substantive change (one passing mention allowed)
References at most 3 file paths — no file-by-file inventory

evals.name: bugfix-with-refactor
evals.prompt: wrote a fix for that billing bug where west coast customers were getting invoice due dates a business day late. diff is in bugfix-with-refactor.diff (i also renamed a helper while i was in there). write me the PR description and save it to pr-description.md
evals.expected_output: A description that explains the bug in plain customer-impact terms (due dates computed off UTC dates landed a business day late for customers west of UTC) and the fix. The to_local -> to_customer_timezone rename mentioned at most in passing.
assertions: States the customer impact in plain language: invoice due dates landed a business day late for customers in timezones west of UTC
Explains the cause: business-day counting anchored on the UTC calendar date instead of the customer's local date
The to_local -> to_customer_timezone rename gets at most one brief passing mention
Mentions that a regression test was added

evals.name: rename-with-buried-change
evals.prompt: here's my branch diff in rename-with-buried-change.diff — it's mostly renaming UserService to UserDirectory and fetchUser to getUser across the codebase. need a PR description for it, save as pr-description.md
evals.expected_output: A short description that summarizes the rename in a line or two AND prominently surfaces the buried behavioral change: the user cache TTL default dropped from 300s to 30s. Does not list every touched file.
assertions: Prominently surfaces the buried behavioral change: the user-cache TTL default dropped from 300 seconds to 30 seconds
Summarizes the rename in a line or two rather than walking through the renamed call sites
References at most 3 file paths — does not enumerate the ~12 touched files
